degree_required.quote: having received a diploma from some reputable medical college or osteopathic college that enforces requirements of four terms of thirty-two weeks for actual instruction in each term

accrediting_body.quote: Any medical college approved and accredited as reputable by the American Medical Association or the Liaison Committee on Medical Education and any osteopathic college approved and accredited as reputable by the American Osteopathic Association is deemed to have complied with the requirements of this subsection.

credential_pegged.quote: having received a diploma from some reputable medical college or osteopathic college that enforces requirements of four terms of thirty-two weeks for actual instruction in each term

required.quote: every applicant for a permanent license as a physician and surgeon shall provide the board with satisfactory evidence of having successfully completed such postgraduate training in hospitals or medical or osteopathic colleges as the board may prescribe by rule.

experience_source.quote: every applicant for a permanent license as a physician and surgeon shall provide the board with satisfactory evidence of having successfully completed such postgraduate training in hospitals or medical or osteopathic colleges as the board may prescribe by rule.

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE)
exams.notes: Steps 1, 2, and 3 must be taken within a seven-year period with no more than three attempts on any step. Applicants graduating on or after January 1, 1994 must pass USMLE or COMLEX. Board may not issue permanent license to applicants who have failed to achieve a passing score within three attempts.
exams.quote: Applicants graduating from a medical or osteopathic college, as described in section 334.031 on or after January 1, 1994, must provide proof of successful completion of the USMLE or the COMLEX

exams.name: Comprehensive Osteopathic Medical Licensing Examination (COMLEX)
exams.notes: Alternative to USMLE for osteopathic graduates on or after January 1, 1994. Same attempt limits apply.
exams.quote: must provide proof of successful completion of the USMLE or the COMLEX

exams.name: Federation Licensing Examination (FLEX)
exams.notes: Board may require FLEX; for pre-1994 graduates as an acceptable alternative. A weighted average score of no less than seventy-five is required to pass.
exams.quote: the board may require applicants to take the Federation Licensing Examination, also known as FLEX, or the United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE)

required.quote: The board shall not renew any certificate of registration unless the licensee shall provide satisfactory evidence that he has complied with the board's minimum requirements for continuing education.

hours_per_period.quote: the state board of registration for the healing arts shall accept toward the fifty-hour license renewal requirement, continuing medical education courses

topical_requirements.quote: the state board of registration for the healing arts shall accept toward the fifty-hour license renewal requirement, continuing medical education courses which have an emphasis on the early diagnosis and treatment of autism in children.

available.quote: Any person who holds a valid current physician and surgeon license issued by another state, a branch or unit of the military, a territory of the United States, or the District of Columbia, and who has been licensed for at least one year in such other jurisdiction, may submit to the board an application for a physician and surgeon license in Missouri

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a valid current license in another jurisdiction for at least one year; board waives examination, educational, or experience requirements if minimum education and experience requirements were met in other jurisdiction. Board may require applicant to pass a Missouri law examination. Military spouses may receive expedited 30-day processing.
requirements.quote: waive any examination, educational, or experience requirements for licensure in this state for the applicant if it determines that there were minimum education requirements and, if applicable, work experience and clinical supervision requirements in effect and the other jurisdiction verifies that the person met those requirements in order to be licensed or certified in that jurisdiction

exists.quote: There is hereby created and established a board to be known as "The State Board of Registration for the Healing Arts" for the purpose of registering, licensing and supervising all physicians and surgeons, and midwives in this state.

national_certification.value: National Board of Medical Examiners; National Board of Examiners for Osteopathic Physicians and Surgeons; Licentiate of the Medical Council of Canada (LMCC)
national_certification.quote: the board, by rule and regulation, may accept the certificate of the National Board of Medical Examiners of the United States, chartered pursuant to the laws of the District of Columbia, of the National Board of Examiners for Osteopathic Physicians and Surgeons chartered pursuant to the laws of the state of Indiana, or of the Licentiate of the Medical Counsel of Canada (LMCC) in lieu of and as equivalent to its own professional examination.

national_association.value: American Medical Association; American Osteopathic Association; Liaison Committee on Medical Education
national_association.quote: Any medical college approved and accredited as reputable by the American Medical Association or the Liaison Committee on Medical Education and any osteopathic college approved and accredited as reputable by the American Osteopathic Association is deemed to have complied with the requirements of this subsection.

credential_type.quote: Upon due application therefor and upon submission by such person of evidence satisfactory to the board that he or she is licensed to practice in this state, and upon the payment of fees required to be paid by this chapter, the board shall issue to such person a certificate of registration.

is_mandatory.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person not now a registered physician within the meaning of the law to practice medicine or surgery in any of its departments

title_protection.quote: Using, or permitting the use of, the person's name under the designation of "Doctor", "Dr.", "M.D.", or "D.O.", or any similar designation with reference to the commercial exploitation of any goods, wares or merchandise

scope_protection.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person not now a registered physician within the meaning of the law to practice medicine or surgery in any of its departments

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of any controlled substance or alcoholic beverage to an extent that impairs ability to perform professional duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of any controlled substance, as defined in chapter 195, or alcoholic beverage to an extent that such use impairs a person's ability to perform the work of any profession licensed or regulated by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Final adjudication of guilt or plea of guilty/nolo contendere for a criminal offense reasonably related to the profession, involving fraud, dishonesty, an act of violence, or moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The person has been finally adjudicated and found guilty, or entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere, in a criminal prosecution under the laws of any state or of the United States, for any offense reasonably related to the qualifications, functions or duties of any profession licensed or regulated pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of fraud, deception, misrepresentation or bribery in securing any certificate, permit or license, or permission to take an examination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of fraud, deception, misrepresentation or bribery in securing any certificate of registration or authority, permit or license issued pursuant to this chapter or in obtaining permission to take any examination given or required pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misconduct, fraud, misrepresentation, dishonesty, unethical or unprofessional conduct in the performance of professional duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misconduct, fraud, misrepresentation, dishonesty, unethical conduct or unprofessional conduct in the performance of the functions or duties of any profession licensed or regulated by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct or practice harmful or dangerous to mental or physical health, or incompetency, gross negligence or repeated negligence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conduct or practice which is or might be harmful or dangerous to the mental or physical health of a patient or the public; or incompetency, gross negligence or repeated negligence in the performance of the functions or duties of any profession licensed or regulated by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of, or attempting to violate, directly or indirectly, or assisting any person to violate, any provision of this chapter or lawful rule
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of, or attempting to violate, directly or indirectly, or assisting or enabling any person to violate, any provision of this chapter or chapter 324, or of any lawful rule or regulation adopted pursuant to this chapter or chapter 324

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impersonation of any person holding a certificate, permit or license, or allowing any person to use the licensee's credentials or diploma
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impersonation of any person holding a certificate of registration or authority, permit or license or allowing any person to use his or her certificate of registration or authority, permit, license or diploma from any school

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, restriction, modification, limitation, reprimand, warning, censure, probation or other final disciplinary action by another state, territory, federal agency or country
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revocation, suspension, restriction, modification, limitation, reprimand, warning, censure, probation or other final disciplinary action against the holder of or applicant for a license or other right to practice any profession regulated by this chapter by another state, territory, federal agency or country

disciplinary_grounds.description: A person finally adjudged incapacitated or disabled by a court of competent jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person is finally adjudged incapacitated or disabled by a court of competent jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assisting or enabling any person to practice who is not registered and currently eligible to practice pursuant to this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Assisting or enabling any person to practice or offer to practice any profession licensed or regulated by this chapter who is not registered and currently eligible to practice pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Issuance of a certificate of registration or authority, permit or license based upon a material mistake of fact
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Issuance of a certificate of registration or authority, permit or license based upon a material mistake of fact

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to display a valid certificate or license if required by this chapter or any rule
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to display a valid certificate or license if so required by this chapter or any rule promulgated pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the drug laws or rules and regulations of this state, including chapter 195, any other state, or the federal government
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the drug laws or rules and regulations of this state, including but not limited to any provision of chapter 195, any other state, or the federal government

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making or causing to be made a false statement in any birth, death or other certificate or document executed in connection with the practice of the profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly making, or causing to be made, or aiding, or abetting in the making of, a false statement in any birth, death or other certificate or document executed in connection with the practice of the person's profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making a false statement, orally or in writing, to the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly making a false statement, orally or in writing to the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting patronage in a manner that confuses, deceives or misleads the public as to the need for or appropriateness of health care services or the qualifications of a person to render them
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Soliciting patronage in person or by agents or representatives, or by any other means or manner, under the person's own name or under the name of another person or concern, actual or pretended, in such a manner as to confuse, deceive, or mislead the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using, or permitting the use of, the licensee's name under the designation of "Doctor", "Dr.", "M.D.", or "D.O." with reference to commercial exploitation of goods, wares or merchandise
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using, or permitting the use of, the person's name under the designation of "Doctor", "Dr.", "M.D.", or "D.O.", or any similar designation with reference to the commercial exploitation of any goods, wares or merchandise

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making or causing to be made a false statement or misrepresentation of a material fact, with intent to defraud, for payment under state or federal assistance programs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly making or causing to be made a false statement or misrepresentation of a material fact, with intent to defraud, for payment pursuant to the provisions of chapter 208 or chapter 630 or for payment from Title XVIII or Title XIX of the Social Security Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure or refusal to properly guard against contagious, infectious or communicable diseases or the spread thereof; maintaining an unsanitary office or performing services under unsanitary conditions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure or refusal to properly guard against contagious, infectious or communicable diseases or the spread thereof; maintaining an unsanitary office or performing professional services under unsanitary conditions

disciplinary_grounds.description: A pattern of personal use or consumption of any controlled substance unless prescribed by another authorized physician
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A pattern of personal use or consumption of any controlled substance unless it is prescribed, dispensed or administered by another physician who is authorized by law to do so

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual intoxication or dependence on alcohol, evidence of which may include more than one alcohol-related enforcement contact
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual intoxication or dependence on alcohol, evidence of which may include more than one alcohol-related enforcement contact as defined by section 302.525

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with a treatment program or an aftercare program entered into as part of a board order, settlement agreement or licensee's professional health program
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with a treatment program or an aftercare program entered into as part of a board order, settlement agreement or licensee's professional health program

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, limitation, probation, or restriction of any controlled substance authority, or voluntary termination while under investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revocation, suspension, limitation, probation, or restriction of any kind whatsoever of any controlled substance authority, whether agreed to voluntarily or not, or voluntary termination of a controlled substance authority while under investigation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Operating or managing an abortion facility that qualifies as an ambulatory surgical center without obtaining or renewing the required license as an ambulatory surgical center
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For a physician to operate, conduct, manage, or establish an abortion facility, or for a physician to perform an abortion in an abortion facility, if such facility comes under the definition of an ambulatory surgical center pursuant to sections 197.200 to 197.240, and such facility has failed to obtain or renew a license as an ambulatory surgical center.

definition_quote.value: Practice of medicine across state lines means the rendering of a written or otherwise documented medical opinion concerning the diagnosis or treatment of a patient within this state by a physician located outside this state
definition_quote.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person not now a registered physician within the meaning of the law to practice medicine or surgery in any of its departments, to engage in the practice of medicine across state lines or to profess to cure and attempt to treat the sick and others afflicted with bodily or mental infirmities, or engage in the practice of midwifery in this state, except as herein provided.

value: treatment of sick and afflicted with bodily or mental infirmities
methods_authorized.quote: practice medicine or surgery in any of its departments, to engage in the practice of medicine across state lines or to profess to cure and attempt to treat the sick and others afflicted with bodily or mental infirmities, or engage in the practice of midwifery

drug_authority.value: Licensed physicians may prescribe, administer, or dispense drugs including controlled substances for therapeutic purposes. Physicians may prescribe controlled substances for intractable pain. Prescribing via telemedicine requires an established physician-patient relationship.
drug_authority.quote: a physician may prescribe, administer or dispense controlled substances for a therapeutic purpose to a person diagnosed and treated by a physician for a condition resulting in intractable pain

citations.kind: controlled substance prescribing for intractable pain

license_status_types.quote: any person licensed pursuant to this chapter may apply to the state board of registration for the healing arts for an inactive license status

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Graduates of foreign medical schools must be recognized by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates; board may enter degree on license based on nature of education and training for foreign-trained licensees
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: at least five of whom shall be graduates of professional schools accredited by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education or recognized by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: No explicit statutory limits on opioid quantities found in provided text; however, prescribing nontherapeutic controlled substances or without valid physician-patient relationship is a disciplinary ground; intractable pain treatment provisions protect therapeutic prescribing
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: No physician shall be subject to disciplinary action by the board solely for prescribing, administering or dispensing controlled substances when prescribed, administered or dispensed for a therapeutic purpose for a person diagnosed and treated by a physician for a condition resulting in intractable pain

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Prior to prescribing through telemedicine or the internet, a physician must establish a valid physician-patient relationship including obtaining a reliable medical history and performing a physical examination. Prescribing based solely on a telephone evaluation is permitted only if a previously established and ongoing physician-patient relationship exists. No prescribing based solely on internet request or questionnaire.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: Prior to prescribing any drug, controlled substance, or other treatment through telemedicine, as defined in section 191.1145, or the internet, a physician shall establish a valid physician-patient relationship as described in section 191.1146.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The member states hereby create the "Interstate Medical Licensure Compact Commission".

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: A physician may enter into collaborative practice arrangements with physician assistants. Collaborative practice arrangements, which shall be in writing, may delegate to a physician assistant the authority to prescribe, administer, or dispense drugs and provide treatment

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician assistants may prescribe drugs, medications, devices or therapies pursuant to a collaborative practice arrangement; may prescribe Schedule III, IV, and V controlled substances and Schedule II hydrocodone (limited to 5-day supply without refill); may not prescribe controlled substances for themselves or family members; must register with DEA if prescribing controlled substances
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: A physician assistant with a certificate of controlled substance prescriptive authority as provided in this section may prescribe any controlled substance listed in Schedule III, IV, or V of section 195.017, and may have restricted authority in Schedule II, when delegated the authority to prescribe controlled substances in a collaborative practice arrangement.

max_physician_assistants_per_supervising.quote: No physician shall be designated to serve as a collaborating physician for more than six full-time equivalent licensed physician assistants, full-time equivalent advanced practice registered nurses, or full-time equivalent assistant physicians, or any combination thereof.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: After a contested hearing before the board, and upon a showing of reasonable cause to believe that a licensee or applicant is unable to practice his or her profession with reasonable skill and safety to the public by reason of medical or osteopathic incompetency, mental, or physical incapacity, or due to the excessive use or abuse of alcohol or controlled substances the board may require a licensee or applicant to submit to an examination.
